title: Core Math Card System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a visual math-card system across counting, shape sorting, fractions, and patterns.
creative_direction: Image 01 locks the card format, manipulable diagram style, and child-friendly mathematical clarity. Images 02-04 preserve the same proportions and visual grammar while shifting the concept being taught.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-counting-cards first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-shape-sorting-cards, 03-fraction-snack-cards, 04-pattern-sequence-cards. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-counting-cards is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
